neighbours.label: the ROY G BIV rainbow mnemonic and the rainbow's colour sequence
fire: Kids learn the rainbow's colors with the name ROY G BIV.
My teacher wrote ROY G BIV on the board in big letters.
The acronym ROY G BIV stands for the seven colors of light.
A prism splits light into red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet.
Just think of ROY G BIV when you draw a rainbow.
The visible band goes from red through yellow and green to indigo and violet.
Art class began with the mnemonic ROY G BIV.
Rainbows always show red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet in order.
quiet: Kids learn the planets' order with a short rhyme.
My teacher wrote our names on the board in big letters.
The acronym NASA stands for a large space agency.
A prism sat on the shelf beside some old books and a lamp.
Just think of your house when you draw a map.
The bus route goes from the school through town to the lake and park.
Art class began with a drawing of a bowl of fruit.
Trains always stop at the first, second, third, fourth, fifth station in order.
